(b) The four paragraph rows of ch 38 (38:1-9, 38:10-13, 38:14-16, 38:17-23) are MERGED into Ezek.38.1-Ezek.38.23 (oracle_against_nation, medium_low, cap disclosed): the messenger formulae at 38:10, 38:14, 38:17 change no addressee (Gog throughout) and follow no refrain (38:9, 38:13, 38:16 carry samekh only), so under §2d.6 — the rule every other part applied to chs 5, 30, 31, 34 — they mark paragraphs; the strategy's §6 E-02 list itself expects '38/39 units' among the whole-chapter spans, and §6 reads 39:1 as a sub-onset inside 38:1's unit. (c) Ezek.37.15-Ezek.37.28 as sign_act with the salvation burden disclosed: RATIFIED (§6 'shares with 3'; no mark inside 37:15-28). current_row.boundary_rationale: Onset: the strict word-event formula reopens at oshb:Ezek.37.15 וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר, followed at 37.16 by the commanded symbolic action (“you, son of man, take one stick”). The row runs as one unbroken masoretic paragraph: no samekh or pe mark is recorded anywhere between 37.14 (behind it) and 37.28, so the tradition itself treats the demonstration (37.16-20) and its spoken interpretation (37.21-28, opened by a messenger formula with no addressee change) as a single section. Close: oshb:Ezek.37.28 carries a wide-family recognition close addressed to “the nations” rather than the strict third-person plural (this expansion sits in the wider 64-verse recognition sweep, not the strict 28-verse list) -- וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בִּהְי֧וֹת מִקְדָּשִׁ֛י בְּתוֹכָ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם -- with a samekh mark recorded immediately after. Both sides were weighed: the onset word-event at 37.15 is one of only 39 strict-form verses in the book, and the samekh-marked recognition close at 37.28 is corroborated from the close side before the next word-event opens the following unit at oshb:Ezek.38.1.

current_row.strongest_rejected_alternative: A split between the stick demonstration and its interpretation, e.g. after 37.20 (‘The sticks... will be in your hand before their eyes’) or after 37.23 (the purification promise). Rejected: no samekh or pe mark falls anywhere inside 37.15-28, and the messenger-formula reopenings at 37.19 and 37.21 do not change addressee, so neither carries the addressee-change condition this campaign requires before a messenger formula is read as a row seam.
current_row.literature_type_guess: two-sticks sign-act with its salvation interpretation
current_row.device_notes: Operative-category disclosure: the 37.15-28 span is anchored as sign_act (the commanded stick action of 37.16-20), but its interpretation at 37.21-28 carries the salvation_oracle burden (gather/return, the covenant of peace at 37.26, ‘my servant David’ and ‘my sanctuary’ devices) -- a one-clause category deviation rather than a split, since no parashah mark or addressee change divides the two halves. 37.16 is a doubled ketiv/qere verse (two notes on one verse, both the same word: written חברו, read חֲבֵרָ֑יו), and 37.19 and 37.22 each carry one further K/Q note in this span (37.22 ketiv יהיה / qere יִֽהְיוּ). A boundary is never argued from any of these Qere readings; they are disclosed as textual-variant sites only.

current_row.boundary_rationale: Onset: the strict word-event formula at oshb:Ezek.38.1 וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר opens the Gog complex; it is immediately corroborated by the set-your-face direction opener at 38.2 (one of only 9 such verses book-wide) and the messenger formula at 38.3 naming the addressee, Gog. The unit is addressed to Gog throughout in the second person, closing on a description of the invading host rather than a text-formula refrain. Close: no recognition or utterance formula falls inside 38.1-9, but a samekh mark is recorded after 38.9 (tier-3 single-witness), and the material that follows at 38.10 reopens with its own messenger formula introducing a distinct divine soliloquy about Gog's mind rather than continuing the second-person mobilization address -- a change of speech-frame weighed from the far side of the seam as well as the near side.

current_row.boundary_rationale: Onset: a fresh messenger formula opens the divine soliloquy about Gog's own intentions, oshb:Ezek.38.10 כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה וְהָיָ֣ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יַעֲל֤וּ דְבָרִים֙ עַל לְבָבֶ֔ךָ וְחָשַׁבְתָּ֖ מַחֲשֶׁ֥בֶת רָעָֽה, using the recurring transition phrase “in that day” that also opens the 38.17-23 and 39.11-16 material in this complex, disclosed as a repeated but untracked device rather than one of the book's twelve closed frame-spine formulae. Close: 38.10-13 ends on the Sheba-Dedan merchants' rhetorical question at 38.13, with a samekh mark recorded immediately after (tier-3 single-witness); 38.14 then reopens with “therefore, prophesy, son of man,” returning the address from Gog to the prophet -- both sides of that seam were weighed together.

current_row.strongest_rejected_alternative: Reading 39.25-29 as the tail of the Gog dossier rather than a distinct unit -- i.e. treating the whole Gog-to-restoration stretch from 39.21 or even 39.1 as one long close. Rejected: the salvation vocabulary here (reversing the captivity, mercy on the whole house of Israel, jealousy for the holy name, no more hidden face) has no verdict-against-Gog content at all, and the close 39.25-29 lands on (utterance formula plus pe) is the same close evidence recorded for the whole restoration collection, not an internal Gog-oracle refrain.
